  Scenario: Error scenario - invalid email format

```gherkin
Feature: Medical User Authentication
  As a medical software system
  I need to authenticate users securely
  To ensure patient data protection and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11

  Background:
    Given the authentication service is initialized
    And audit logging is enabled per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
    And test admin access is <test_admin_status>

  @happy_path
  Scenario: Valid clinician credentials are accepted
    Given a registered clinician with email "doctor@hospital.org"
    And a valid password "SecurePass123"
    When they authenticate with these credentials
    Then authentication should succeed
    And a valid session token should be returned
    And an audit log entry should record the successful login
    And the token structure should comply with security standards

  @validation @email
  Scenario Outline: Email validation rules are enforced
    Given an authentication attempt with email "<email>"
    And a valid password "ValidPass123"
    When the system validates the credentials
    Then the request should fail with error "Invalid email format"
    And no session token should be generated
    And the failed attempt should be logged with reason "Invalid email"

    Examples:
      | email                 |
      | missing@domain        |
      | user@hospital         |
      | user@hospital.        |
      | user@.com             |
      | morethan254chars@longdomainnamethatiswaytoolongtobevalidandshouldberejectedbythesystemaccordingtotherfc5322specificationwhichstatesthatemailaddressesshouldnotexceed254charactersinlength.com |

  @validation @password
  Scenario Outline: Password complexity rules are enforced
    Given a registered clinician with email "nurse@clinic.org"
    And password "<password>"
    When the system validates the credentials
    Then the request should fail with error "Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase and digit"
    And no session token should be generated
    And the failed attempt should be logged with reason "Invalid password"

    Examples:
      | password     |
      | short1       |
      | NOLOWERCASE1 |
      | nodigitshere |
      | 12345678     |
      |              |

  @compliance @audit_trail
  Scenario: Failed authentication is properly logged
    Given an authentication attempt with email "unknown@hospital.org"
    And password "WrongPass123"
    When the system processes the request
    Then the attempt should fail
    And an audit log entry should record:
      | Field         | Value Pattern            |
      | Timestamp     | not null                 |
      | UserAttempted | unknown@hospital.org     |
      | Status        | Failed                   |
      | Reason        | Invalid credentials      |
      | IPAddress     | not null                 |

  @edge_case @age
  Scenario Outline: Age-based discounts are calculated correctly
    Given a patient aged <age> years
    And a medication cost of $100.00
    When calculating the age discount
    Then the discount should be <discount>%

    Examples:
      | age | discount |
      | 64  | 0        |
      | 65  | 15       |
      | 66  | 15       |
      | 20  | 0        |
      | 21  | 5        |
      | 22  | 5        |

  @security @token
  Scenario: Invalid token structure is rejected
    Given an invalid session token "invalid!token#structure"
    When the system validates the token
    Then the validation should fail
    And the reason should be logged as "Invalid token structure"

  @compliance @test_accounts
  Scenario: Test admin access is properly controlled
    Given test admin access is <enabled>
    When authenticating with email "admin@test.com"
    And password "password123"
    Then authentication should <result>

    Examples:
      | enabled | result     |
      | true    | succeed    |
      | false   | fail       |

  @error_handling
  Scenario: System handles malformed requests gracefully
    Given a malformed authentication request
    When the system processes the request
    Then the service should return a validation error
    And no authentication attempt should be recorded
    And the error should be logged with severity "Warning"

  @boundary @session
  Scenario: Token generation handles maximum length email
    Given a clinician with email "very.long.email.address.that.is.254.characters@longdomainnamethatiswaytoolongtobevalidandshouldberejectedbythesystemaccordingtotherfc5322specificationwhichstatesthatemailaddressesshouldnotexceed254charactersinlength.com"
    And valid credentials
    When generating a session token
    Then the token should be valid
    And the token should contain the full email address
```

1. Audit trail requirements (21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e))
2. Electronic signature requirements (implied in token validation)
3. Operational system checks (validation rules)
4. Authority checks (test admin control)
5. Device checks (token structure validation)

The scenarios test:
- Happy paths for successful authentication
- All validation rules with concrete examples
- Boundary conditions (age discounts, email length)
- Compliance requirements (audit logging)
- Error conditions (malformed requests, invalid tokens)

Each scenario maintains medical domain relevance while testing the core authentication logic.
